# fw-config crate

> Codex-compatible config.toml model for aphrody: ConfigToml, model providers (managed llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI, Anthropic, ChatGPT)…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-config/

Codex-compatible config.toml model for aphrody: ConfigToml, model providers (managed llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI, Anthropic, ChatGPT), layered merge (built-ins < Codex-compat < user < project < profile < -c overrides < CLI flags), dotted -c override parsing, and the No-Human-In-The-Loop policy defaults. Pure, no filesystem access in the core, wasm32-safe.
